name: gomlx-preflight-dataset-cardinality-and-step-6e3d
instr:
Let callers inspect dataset cardinality before iteration and safely plan bounded training or evaluation work. Cardinality must compose through dataset transformations and agree with the batches actually consumed, including distributed batches. Planned runs must reconcile predicted availability with completion, exhaustion, and failure without changing existing iteration or evaluation behavior.

The `github.com/gomlx/gomlx/ml/train` package exposes the cardinality, planning, reporting, loop, and evaluation APIs named below. `CardinalityOf` performs side-effect-free inspection; datasets without the optional `CardinalityDataset` capability remain valid and return `CardinalityUnknown`, while built-in sources return honest finite, unbounded, or unknown bounds. Every composed dataset derives cardinality in iterator execution order: `Take` clamps, `Batch` and distributed accumulation use checked remainder-aware arithmetic, and `Buffer`, `OnDevice`, and ordered or unordered `ParallelMap` preserve counts. Unrepresentable finite arithmetic becomes unknown rather than wrapping. `PlanDatasetSteps` caps automatic or oversized work to exact finite availability, preserves smaller explicit requests, and returns `ErrAutomaticStepsUnavailable` when unknown or unbounded input lacks a positive explicit limit. Planned execution counts completed loop steps, distinguishes ordinary exhaustion from exhaustion below a declared finite lower bound, and returns iterator errors without reporting successful
